record.name: Ecwid
record.one_liner: Ecwid provides an ecommerce REST API, JavaScript API, and webhooks managed via OAuth 2.0.

auth.notes: We use OAuth 2.0 authorization simplified for single-store customizations, JSON-formatted data, and a clear structure.

access.notes: Ecwid creates one custom app for any user who visits the app dashboard in Ecwid admin for the first time, granting direct access.

api_surface.notes: Supports a REST API, webhooks, and a client-side JavaScript API.

evidence.claim: Users can generate custom apps in the admin dashboard for self-serve access.
